structural_results.beta_vacuity: punctured (beta-type) critical deletion steps force the deleted element into Stab(M(S)); impossible for aperiodic supports (paper Prop 4.12); machine-confirmed on 507,133 classified supports, zero beta steps
structural_results.parity_obstruction: at odd moduli the miss set always has even size: no singleton-miss supports exist; floor family |F| = 2, auto-maximal, window-shaped
structural_results.hajos_payoff: Conjecture A restricted to Hajos orders (d = 2m, m in {1, p^a, pq, p^2 q, pqr}) suffices for the polylog tier at the same exponent up to o(1), via a Chen-type P3 count of good residuals
structural_results.count_growth: log2(maximal supports)/sqrt(d) approx 2.6-2.8 at d = 31..72, consistent with the 2^{c sqrt(d)} lower-bound theorem
